title: Coarse information and finite rank obstructions for flat lattice Hodge forms
abstract: On a finite periodic lattice with unit spacing, we derive necessary coarse-information rank budgets for flat Hodge forms and constructed derivative repairs. For nonnegative componentwise repair weights, local coercivity on actual divergence-free fields with a fixed positive constant forces the output dimensions of differentiable observations to diverge when one directional spatial mean is subquadratic in lattice side length. The proof derives an exact transverse-character trace formula and composes it with the actual local derivative-kernel bound. A constructed quadratic-weight repair and arithmetic-mean observation show that fixed output dimension becomes possible at quadratic weight scale. Explicit polynomial/Lipschitz and C1 counterexamples retain the necessity of the stated quadratic penalty upper hypothesis in the merely differentiable observation class. Prior finite-rank, tangent and exact regular-sector results are consolidated with separately pinned Lean evidence and analytic arguments. Classical mechanisms are distinguished from original priority and physical relevance. No interacting or continuum Yang-Mills mass gap is established.
